strict_policy: Unchanged: reject every missing allele on retained biallelic sites
optional_policy: Complete-site filtering only; no imputation, no inferred phase; preserve all retained allele calls and original IDs

actual_input_gate.denominator: All in-map biallelic variant records before missing-call filtering

thinning.method: Uniform without replacement exactly floor(0.25*N) records per chromosome; original prepared complete-call VCF

comparison: Frozen intact structural integer-edge development predictions; same 585 pairs; no selection or fitting
limitation: Reused development diagnostic under uniform MCAR whole-site thinning; not independent confirmation or robustness to structured missingness, allele-dependent missingness, or phase error. Passing does not change strict qualification.
release_rule: Optional drop-site path disabled until every fixed diagnostic gate passes and root independently verifies results; complete-call path preferred. Root owns final inputs and one final submission.
